verdict.rationale: Appwrite has no named sandbox or test-mode feature. Its own documented pieces do allow testing apart from production. It can be self-hosted anywhere Docker runs, and the CLI accepts an --endpoint flag to target such an instance. Functions advertise "develop locally, deploy when ready," and Sites give non-production branches preview links. A hands-on tester also credited the containerized setup with making offline dev and testing easier. missing for 10: a first-class sandbox/staging environment or data branching with documented isolation from production data, seeding or cloning of test data, and evidence that Sites previews use non-production backend data.
